tenders.title: Security Assessment - LTC - 2435/2026 - Materials Department
tenders.summary: KAHRAMAA seeks to engage a specialized company to provide professional cybersecurity assessment services to enhance the security posture of its cloud and on-premises infrastructure and related services. The objective is to identify and assess existing security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and compliance gaps within cloud and on-premises computing environments, and to support the implementation of remediation measures based on risk assessments. The project consists of three components to be performed annually over a period of three (3) years: - Part 1: Comprehensive security assessment and penetration testing (one assessment annually). - Part 2: Flexible assessments based on emerging requirements (two additional assessments annually). - Part 3: Verification of the remediation and closure of findings resulting from each assessment.
